title: Apparel Return Window
text: Apparel items may be returned within 10 days of delivery. The product should be unused, unwashed, and returned with its original tags whenever applicable.

title: Footwear Return Window
text: Footwear may be returned within 10 days of delivery. Shoes and sandals should be returned unused and preferably with the original box and accessories.

title: Electronics Return Window
text: Eligible electronics may be reported for replacement or return within 7 days of delivery. The item may be inspected when the complaint involves damage, missing accessories, or a functional defect.

title: Home Category Return Window
text: Eligible home-category products may be returned within 10 days of delivery. Products should be returned with supplied accessories and packaging when reasonably possible.

title: Beauty Product Returns
text: Beauty and personal-care products are returnable only when the item is eligible and remains unopened or when it arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect. Used or opened hygiene-sensitive products may be excluded from normal returns.

title: COD Refund Timeline
text: For an approved return originally paid using Cash on Delivery, the refund is processed to the customer's selected eligible refund method. Refund processing generally begins after the returned product passes the required return checks.

title: Prepaid Refund Timeline
text: Approved refunds for prepaid orders are normally initiated back to the original or eligible payment method after required return checks. The final credit time can depend on the customer's bank or payment provider.

title: Standard Delivery SLA
text: The estimated delivery date shown for an order is based on the seller, destination, inventory availability, and logistics network. Customers should use the latest order-tracking status for the current expected delivery timeline.

title: Delayed Delivery
text: If an order passes its expected delivery date, the customer should check the latest tracking update before reporting a delay. Support may review the logistics status and provide the latest available delivery information.

title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
text: Reverse pickup is available only for return-eligible products and serviceable pickup locations. When reverse pickup is unavailable, an alternative return method may be provided according to the order's return eligibility.

title: Return Condition Requirements
text: A returned item should normally include the product, accessories, manuals, tags, and original packaging when applicable. A return may be rejected when the item is damaged after delivery or important supplied components are missing.

title: Wrong or Damaged Product
text: Customers should report an incorrect, damaged, or defective product within the applicable return or replacement window. Support may request order details and evidence needed to validate the reported issue.

title: Order Cancellation
text: An order can generally be cancelled while cancellation remains available in the order workflow. Once shipping or delivery progresses beyond the cancellation stage, the customer may need to use the applicable return process instead.

title: Non-Returnable Items
text: Some products may be marked non-returnable because of hygiene, safety, customization, or category-specific restrictions. A damaged, defective, or incorrect delivery may still qualify for support according to the applicable listing and order conditions.
